title: Adult clinical seizure-event detection
scientific_question: Can a causal EEG detector identify annotated ictal events across complete held Siena patient recordings at an acceptable observed-time false-alarm burden?
primary_outputs: Siena recording-relative seizure intervals after explicit reconciliation of source clock annotations and native EDF start clocks.

recording_contract.neural: Representative EDF header: 35 channels at 512 Hz, including 29 labeled EEG channels plus EKG/SPO2/HR/auxiliary/marker channels; 2,625 one-second records. Neural-only input must exclude auxiliary and MK channels.
recording_contract.labels: 14-row subject_info.csv records patient ID, age, sex, seizure type, localization/lateralization, EEG channel count and seizure count; event files give clock-based seizure starts/ends. Counts sum to 47 seizures.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Subtract registration start from seizure clock, handling day wrap and known source corrections. Actual PN00-1 event is 1143–1213 s. PN00-3 source has an impossible one-hour-long end-time typo; official parser corrects end time to18.29.29 and handles other filename/spacing exceptions.
recording_contract.biological_ids: 14 independent PN patient identifiers, with multiple files per patient; all files remain grouped. This is a separate adult cohort from pediatric CHB-MIT, not a processed CHB subset.
recording_contract.evidence: 41-file manifest, 14-row subject table, actual event text, 9,216-byte EDF header and source correction/annotation parser inspected; no signal samples downloaded.

primary.name: patient_macro_event_f1

primary.rationale: Requires event coverage across complete monitoring while compulsory false-alarm and sensitivity metrics expose threshold tradeoffs.

comparators.inputs: Elapsed monitoring time and training annotations, no EEG
comparators.procedure: Implemented training-only nuisance comparator under the same patient split.

comparators.name: Constant detector
comparators.procedure: Necessary degenerate control retained with sensitivity and occupancy; no constant-output rejection as a shortcut.

nuisance_controls: Exclude all non-EEG channel roles using original header provenance.
Preserve entire observed background and record boundaries.

evaluation.uncertainty: Implemented paired patient bootstrap summarizes F1 differences descriptively. Retain all selected patients and full 14-person roster before interpreting a complete-cohort effect; overlapping fitted models and clinical selection limit generalization.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject patient overlap, missing recordings, nonfinite/incomplete scores and prohibited channels. Clock/source ambiguity blocks the affected scientific evaluation rather than silently dropping the file.
